scenes.title: Clean Price vs. Cash (Dirty) Price in Bond Options

beatOutlines.textOutline: Compare Clean Price: quoted bond market price that excludes accrued interest ([fact-03]).
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: Compare Cash (Dirty) Price: Quoted Price plus Accrued Interest ($	ext{Cash Price} = 	ext{Clean Price} + 	ext{Accrued Interest}$), which is strictly required for Black's forward bond price $F_0$ ([fact-03]).
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

scenes.title: Deconstructing Caplet and Floorlet Black Valuation Formulas

beatOutlines.textOutline: Break down Caplet Formula: $c_k = e^{-r t_{k+1}} \delta_k L [F_k N(d_1) - R_K N(d_2)]$ valuing call options on forward interest rates ([fact-05]).
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: Break down Floorlet Formula: $p_k = e^{-r t_{k+1}} \delta_k L [R_K N(-d_2) - F_k N(-d_1)]$ valuing put options on interest rates ([fact-06]).
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

scenes.title: Business Snapshot 21.1 & 21.2: MBS Prepayments & Negative Rates

beatOutlines.textOutline: Examine MBS Negative Convexity: 30-year mortgages with penalty-free prepayments expose MBS investors to negative convexity as rates fall ([fact-11]).

beatOutlines.textOutline: Examine Negative Rates: post-2015 European negative rates broke standard lognormal Black models, forcing shifted Black and Bachelier normal models ([fact-11]).

scenes.title: Cap Purchase vs. Floor Sale in Zero-Cost Collars

beatOutlines.textOutline: Balance Cap Purchase: caps floating rate above $R_{	ext{cap}}$, requiring upfront premium payment ([fact-07]).
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: Balance Floor Sale: sells a floor at $R_{	ext{floor}}$ to collect premium, perfectly offsetting the cap cost in a zero-cost collar ([fact-07]).

beatOutlines.textOutline: Plot Net Trading Profit: caplet payoff minus initial premium paid compounded at risk-free rate ([fact-05]).

summarySteps: 1. Embedded Bond Options ([fact-01]): Callable bonds grant issuer buybacks; putable bonds grant holder early principal repayment.
2. Black's Bond Option Model ([fact-02]): Values European bond options using forward cash (dirty) price $F_0$.
3. Clean vs. Dirty Price ([fact-03]): Cash Price equals Quoted Clean Price plus Accrued Interest, essential for Black's model inputs.
4. Interest Rate Caps ([fact-04]): Portfolios of European call caplets protecting floating-rate borrowers against rising rates above $R_K$.
5. Caplet Valuation Formula ([fact-05]): $c_k = e^{-r t_{k+1}} \delta_k L [F_k N(d_1) - R_K N(d_2)]$ valuing individual caplets.
6. Zero-Cost Collars ([fact-07]): Combines cap purchase and floor sale such that premium received offsets premium paid.
7. Cap-Floor-Swap Parity ([fact-08]): $	ext{Cap} - 	ext{Floor} = 	ext{Interest Rate Swap}$, linking options and swaps synthetically.
8. Swaptions ([fact-10]): Options to enter into interest rate swaps at future date $T_0$ (payer vs. receiver swaptions).
bottomTakeaway: Interest rate derivatives like bond options, caps, floors, collars, and swaptions apply Black's 1976 model to forward rates and dirty bond prices, governing floating-rate risk management and swap parity relationships ([fact-02], [fact-05], [fact-08], [fact-10]).
